svg.title: 10c My outcomes (NREP)
svg.text: Outcomes NREP has harvested. SNV categorises and approves them before they count towards System Signals.

g.text: Returned by SNV: “Isingiro dairy cooperative adopted solar milk chilling…”
Grace Akello: please add the cooperative's before/after spoilage records as evidence, then resubmit.
Isingiro dairy cooperative adopted solar milk chilling, cutting spoilage losses

MEMD included productive use of solar in agriculture in the draft energy policy review
Isingiro women's groups negotiated reserved time on solar irrigation schemes
